# TechGeekBuzz

> TechGeekBuzz is a comprehensive tech education platform offering free tutorials, certifications, developer roadmaps, and interview preparation across programming languages and frameworks.

The site provides in-depth learning resources for multiple programming languages including Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, and PHP, alongside modern frameworks like Angular and DevOps tools like Docker. It also features developer career roadmaps, practical tools, and blog content covering emerging technologies like AI and cybersecurity.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Java
- C++
- SQL
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Web Development
- Data Structures
- Docker
- Angular
- Backend Development
- Database Management
- Interview Preparation
- Programming Fundamentals
- DevOps

## Programming Language Tutorials

- [Python Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/python): Comprehensive Python tutorial covering fundamentals, OOP, and syntax basics for beginners
- [Java Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/java): Java programming tutorial covering OOP, inheritance, and JDK/JRE fundamentals
- [C++ Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/c++): C++ tutorial with object-oriented programming concepts and advanced programming topics
- [JavaScript Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/javascript): JavaScript tutorial for web development covering syntax, functions, and object fundamentals
- [PHP Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/php): PHP server-side scripting tutorial for backend development with MySQL and web applications
- [Scala Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/scala): Scala programming language tutorial combining OOP and functional programming paradigms

## Web Development & Frontend

- [HTML Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/html): HTML markup language tutorial covering basics, forms, and web design fundamentals
- [CSS Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/css): CSS styling guide with layout design and responsive design techniques for web development
- [Angular Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/angular): Angular frontend framework tutorial with TypeScript, components, and SPA development

## Database & Data Structures

- [SQL Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/sql): SQL and RDBMS tutorial covering database management, queries, and data manipulation
- [Data Structure Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/data-structure): Data structures and algorithms tutorial covering sorting, searching, and linked lists

## DevOps & Infrastructure

- [Docker Tutorial](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/tutorial/docker): Docker containerization tutorial with Docker Compose and cloud-native application deployment

## Career Development & Roadmaps

- [Developer Roadmaps](https://www.techgeekbuzz.com/roadmap): Developer career roadmaps for backend, frontend, DevOps, and database administration paths
